primary_exposure.formula: exposure_bits ~ log10_frequency * C(architecture, Sum) + log10_frequency * C(scale, Sum) + C(seed) + C(canary_id)
primary_exposure.estimator: ordinary least squares with canary-clustered sandwich covariance
primary_exposure.primary_contrast: grand-mean log10_frequency coefficient under sum coding
primary_exposure.ceiling_handling: all finite values in primary model; at_ceiling=false sensitivity when column is available

primary_novelty.formula: is_novel ~ log10_frequency * C(architecture, Sum) + log10_frequency * C(scale, Sum) + C(seed) + C(setting)
primary_novelty.estimator: binomial GEE, canary clusters, exchangeable working correlation
primary_novelty.primary_contrast: grand-mean log10_frequency coefficient under sum coding
primary_novelty.fallback: binomial GEE with independence working correlation; if that also fails, analysis stops for a dated amendment
primary_novelty.labels: only complete adjudicated human V/T/N labels; blanks or any other value are fatal

multiplicity.families: the three architecture-by-frequency interactions are adjusted within each primary endpoint

reporting.interpretation: effect estimates and uncertainty are primary; no outcome-driven exclusions or seed additions
